superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Connectorov redosled svežine: DanubeHIS je primljen pre 15 min, pre građanskih senzora sa prijemom pre 20 min i meteoroloških stanica i parkinga sa prijemom pre 25 min. Ne mogu da pretvorim prikazanu promenu na Obilićevom vencu sa 403 na 135 u dokaz trenutnog priliva: parking ne daje vreme merenja. [F35][F3][F27][F4][F5]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector’s freshness ranking: DanubeHIS arrived 15 min ago, ahead of citizen sensors at 20 min and weather stations and parking at 25 min [F35][F3][F27][F4]. I cannot turn Obilićev venac’s displayed change from 403 to 135 into evidence of a current influx: parking supplies no measurement time [F5][F4].
questions_sr: Da li bi odložena ažuriranja parkinga mogla da objasne prikazanu promenu na Obilićevom vencu? [F4][F5]
